title: Padrino de las sillas
desc: Being asked to pay for part of somebody’s quince
setting: Marcos has been talking about his daughter's fifteenth for three months and has finally stopped talking.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Vos sabés que los quince salen caros.
steps.en: You know a quince works out expensive.

options.en: I can imagine. How are you putting it together?
options.feedback: You showed you understood and asked how, which is the opening he needs to name the padrinos.
Agreement. He is trying to get somewhere and you have not helped him.

options.en: And why do you all spend so much?
options.feedback: Judging the whole thing thirty seconds before he asks you to be part of it.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Con padrinos. Uno del pastel, otro de la música.
steps.en: With godparents. One of the cake, another of the music.

options.en: Ah, right. And is one still missing?
options.feedback: You opened the door for him instead of making him push it. That is a kindness he will remember.

options.en: What a good way of doing it.
options.feedback: True. It appreciates the system and steps back from it.

options.en: We do not do that where I come from.
options.feedback: Possibly the least useful sentence available at that moment.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.en: The chairs are missing. Two hundred, rented.

options.es: Yo se las pongo. Contá con eso.
options.en: I will cover them. Count on it.
options.feedback: Said before he finished asking, and with a number in it. That is how a padrino answers.

options.en: And how much does that come to?
options.feedback: Fair, and asking the price first turns a padrinazgo into a quote.

options.es: Déjame ver cómo ando de plata.
options.en: Let me see how I am for money.
options.feedback: Honest. It will be heard as a no, and the chairs will fall to somebody else.

options.es: Ideay, no es nada. Es tu hija.
options.en: Ideay, it is nothing. It is your daughter.
options.feedback: Waves off the thanks and names the reason. Between compadres that is the whole exchange.
Fine. It answers the words and not the fact that he asked you and not his brother.

options.en: We will sort out the payment later.
options.feedback: There is no payment. You have just turned a gift into an invoice.
